about_the_game:
Play as conspiracy theorist Dirk Brownwater, illegally camping in Echo National Park to prove aliens exist—but now the aliens are hunting him. Use your makeshift detector to identify which elk aren’t from this planet and capture them before it’s too late.

          Use social deduction to uncover which elk are other players trying to blend in

                            Drag elk back to your truck and toss them in your flatbed

                      Submit proof of all the captured aliens back at your shelter

Four aliens are sent to investigate a hunter who knows too much. Disguised as elk, they must evade his surveillance and destroy every camera before revealing their true form and abducting him.

                Avoid making noise & alerting the hunter while destroying his surveillance

          Resist screeching to the sound of the hunter's detector by spamming buttons

             You can now begin your covert invasion and drag the hunter back to your ship

content_descriptors.notes: Hoofobia includes hunting and shooting elk which includes blood. The hunter character includes periodic cuss words and cussing when knocked over.

short_description: Hoofobia is an exhilarating asymmetrical horror with up to 5 players. The hunter must locate and capture all aliens disguised as elk, and the aliens must abduct him without leaving a trace.
